Great to have Inferact as an API launch partner for M3.1 Flash!

Thanks for bringing your vLLM expertise to the collaboration. Excited to keep building the serving infrastructure for complex agent workloads together.

[IDÉZETT POSZT, amelyet MiniMax (official) megosztott. Eredeti szerzője: Inferact (@inferact); megjelent: 2026-10-19T12:17:59+00:00; link: https://x.com/inferact/status/2112156303485464598; média: nincs média]
Inferact is an API launch partner for MiniMax M3.1 Flash! 🎉

We're working with @MiniMax_AI on production inference for its latest model, built for multi-step automation, real-codebase engineering and visual reasoning.

M3.1 Flash scored 29.6 on Agents’ Last Exam (ALE), alongside 72.5% on AutomationBench-AA and 73.67% on DeepSWE—capabilities that matter when agents need to plan work, use tools and carry tasks through.

Our contribution is the serving stack: bringing our vLLM engineering and the Inferact Platform to the collaboration.

Thanks to the MiniMax team for the partnership.

Explore the model and API integration:
https://platform.minimax.io/docs/guides/text-generation
